court_cases: Multiple Indian court/tribunal cases found on Indian Kanoon (indiankanoon.org/search/?formInput="Frick India"), 351 documents total, predominantly tax/excise/arbitration matters. Party role: mostly petitioner/appellant or respondent in tax disputes. Examples with dates: Frick India Ltd vs Union of India (Supreme Court, 21.12.1989); Frick India Ltd vs State of Haryana (Supreme Court, 13.05.1994); Commissioner of Central Excise, Delhi vs M/s Frick India Ltd (Supreme Court, 21.09.2007); Chowdhury and Gulzar Singh vs Frick India Limited (Delhi HC, 30.08.1978); Commissioner of Income Tax vs Frick India Ltd (Delhi HC, 02.09.2014); Frick India Ltd vs CCE (CESTAT Delhi, 10.07.2006); Frick India Ltd vs Joint CIT (ITAT Delhi, 16.08.2001); Frick India Ltd vs Sharma Cold Storage and Ice Factory (Patna HC, 10.04.1985); M/s Frick India Ltd vs MP Micro and Small Enterprises Facilitation Council (MP HC 24.07.2015 and Supreme Court 28.03.2016). All appear to be commercial/tax/arbitration litigation, not criminal matters. Per project rule 2 these are not rejection grounds.
